description: Shared English pack: common machine-writing tics. Every rule carries bad and good examples tested by tests/run_tests.py.

rules.pattern: \b(?:it|this|that|the (?:problem|point|goal|issue|question|answer))(?:['’]s not| is not| isn['’]t| was not| wasn['’]t)\b[^!?\n]{1,80}?[,;.:]\s*(?:it|this|that|the [a-z]+)(?:['’]s| is| was)\b
rules.message: State what it is. Drop the straw man you knock down first.
bad: It's not a tool, it's a habit.
This isn't about speed. It's about trust.
The problem is not the price; the problem is the onboarding.
good: It's not ready yet, so we wait until Monday.
It is not cheap: plans start at 49 euros.

rules.message: Say the second half directly, with its fact.
bad: It is not just a CRM but a growth engine.
We are not only fast but also cheap.
good: Not just yet.
It works, but only on Chrome.

rules.message: Say what the reader gets, once.
bad: No setup. No meetings. Just results.
good: No setup is needed. Install the plugin and connect your inbox.

rules.pattern: \b(?:delve[sd]?|delving|tapestry|testament to|game[- ]chang(?:er|ers|ing)|cutting[- ]edge|world[- ]class|best[- ]in[- ]class|next[- ]level|unlock(?:s|ing)? (?:the |your |its )?(?:full |true )?potential|in today['’]s (?:fast[- ]paced|digital|ever[- ]changing|competitive) (?:world|landscape|market)|ever[- ](?:evolving|changing) landscape|navigat(?:e|ing) the complexit(?:y|ies)|plays? a (?:pivotal|crucial|vital|key) role|cannot be overstated)\b
rules.message: Delete the phrase and put the fact, the number or the name in its place.
bad: Let's delve into the data.
A game-changer for small teams.
Our cutting-edge engine.
Unlock your full potential.
good: We changed the onboarding flow.
The edge case fails on Safari.

rules.message: Replace with the concrete verb or fact (use, cut, add, 3 clicks).
bad: We leverage AI to streamline your workflow.
good: We use a script to cut the export from 40 minutes to 2.

rules.message: Delete the adverb. If the sentence loses nothing, it was empty; if it does, add the fact instead.
bad: This is truly unique.
It is incredibly fast.
good: It loads in 0.8 seconds.

rules.message: Give the information instead of asking a question you answer yourself.
bad: The result? A 3x lift.
We cut the price. Why? Churn was high.
good: What does the result show for March?

rules.message: Turn the question and its short answer into one statement.
bad: Want more leads? Fix your page.
good: Do you export to CSV? The export button sits in Settings, under Data, next to the import.

rules.pattern: \b(?:here['’]s (?:the (?:thing|kicker|catch|twist|truth|deal|secret)|where it gets interesting|what (?:most people|nobody|no one) (?:miss(?:es)?|tells? you|talks? about|knows?))|let that sink in|plot twist|spoiler(?: alert)?\s?:|(?:nobody|no one) (?:talks about|tells you|is talking about)|but wait,? there['’]s more|buckle up)
rules.message: Delete the teaser and give the fact.
bad: Here's the thing: churn is a pricing problem.
Let that sink in.
Nobody talks about this.
good: Here is the export for March.

rules.pattern: \b(?:(?:method|approach|thesis|difference|idea|strategy|logic|answer|secret|lesson|rule|playbook|pitch|philosophy|vision|all|everything)\s+(?:fits|can be summed up)\b[^.!?\n]{0,20}?\b(?:one|a single|two|three) (?:line|sentence|word|page|paragraph)s?\b|(?:comes|boils) down to (?:one|a single|two|three) (?:thing|word|question|idea)s?\b|in a nutshell\b|in (?:one|a single) (?:sentence|word|line)\s*:)
rules.message: Write the content itself; do not announce how short it will be.
bad: Our method fits in one sentence.
It all boils down to one thing.
In one word: focus.
good: The contract fits on two pages of A4.
The answer came down to the wire on Friday.

rules.message: Explain with the real case instead of an invented scene.
bad: Imagine a world where invoices pay themselves.
good: We imagined the feature in March and shipped it in May.

rules.pattern: \b(?:I hope this helps|great question|in conclusion,|in summary,|let['’]s (?:dive|jump) (?:in|into)|without further ado|as an AI\b|in this (?:article|post|guide),? (?:we|I)(?:['’]ll| will)|whether you['’]re a|feel free to)
rules.message: Delete the ritual sentence; start or end on the content.
bad: In conclusion, focus wins.
Let's dive in.
Whether you're a founder or a marketer, this works.
good: The conclusion of the audit is in section 3.

rules.message: End the sentence before the participle, or replace it with the evidence.
bad: Revenue grew 20%, highlighting the strength of the model.
The team shipped twice a week, fostering a culture of speed.
good: Highlighting a row turns it yellow.

rules.pattern: \b(?:(?:a |this )?(?:pivotal|watershed|defining) moment|lasting legacy|(?:a|the) new era|(?:the )?next era|changes? everything|chang(?:e|ing) the world|paradigm shift|(?:redefin|reshap|transform)(?:e|es|ing) the (?:future|landscape|industry|way we)|the future of [a-z]+ is (?:here|now)|unprecedented|stands? as a (?:testament|beacon))\b
rules.message: Size the claim to the facts: say what changed, for whom, by how much.
bad: This launch marks a new era for founders.
It changes everything.
An unprecedented opportunity.
good: The new pricing changes the invoice layout.

rules.pattern: \b(?:at the (?:heart|core) of|in the realm of|in the world of|journey|ecosystem)\b
rules.message: Name the actual thing (the market, the network, the process).
bad: Customers are at the heart of everything we do.
good: The heart rate monitor ships in May.

rules.pattern: \b(?:the|this|that|our|your|their) (?:data|numbers?|platform|tool|product|strategy|approach|method|framework|process|system|market|algorithm|software|AI|model|funnel|dashboard|hat|page)\s+(?:decides?|knows?|wants?|believes?|thinks?|understands?|refuses?|forgives?|rewards?|punishes?|cares?|remembers?|does the (?:rest|heavy lifting|work for you)|tells? (?:you|the story)|speaks? for itself|speak for themselves|(?:does|do)n['’]t lie)\b
rules.message: Put the person who acts back as the subject (you decide, we review, the buyer chooses).
bad: The data decides.
The numbers speak for themselves.
The platform does the heavy lifting.
good: The founder decides the price.
The dashboard shows weekly revenue.

rules.message: Name the source with its link, or state it as your own view.
bad: Studies show that founders sleep less.
good: A 2024 survey by the ministry (link) counts 1,200 respondents.

rules.message: Give a sourced number, or speak about the reader directly.
bad: Most founders ignore SEO.
good: You can check SEO in ten minutes.

rules.message: Merge the short punch sentences into one sentence that carries a fact.
bad: You build. You test. You learn.
good: You build the page on Monday and test it with five users on Tuesday.
2. Propose angles. You pick one.

rules.message: A spaced hyphen reads as a dash: use a period, a comma or a colon.
bad: We shipped it - finally.
good: A two-step check runs first.

rules.message: Replace the em dash with a period, a comma, a colon or parentheses.
bad: We shipped it — finally.
good: We shipped it, finally.

rules.message: Replace the spaced en dash with a period, a comma or a colon. Ranges take a plain hyphen: 10-20.
bad: We shipped it – finally.
good: Pages 10–20 hold the data.
